name: G.U.S. Third Measure
crew_model: Three-person Ranger crew: two field agents and one logistics / gunboat systems officer.
narrative_significance: Special-service Ranger-class gunboat hosted aboard the G.U.S. Judicator Prime and assigned to the Kharis sector campaign.
hosted_asset_status: Independent Union Marshals asset hosted, sustained, launched, and recovered by Judicator Prime under JUDICATOR-HOST-001.
task_group_relationship: Supported by the Judicator Prime Task Group but not absorbed into its naval chain of command.
canonical_capabilities: Drone launch, recovery, recharge, repair, control, and evidence ingestion
Rapid concealment through signature reduction rather than true cloaking
Command, habitation, resupply, evidence, and extraction support for its crew
Remote or autonomous hold under qualified Ranger control
placement_rule: no_fixed_coordinates: mobile asset holds no fixed map placement; position is asserted per-event with route and drive continuity.
notes: The vessel name, crew binding, hosted status, and mission role are owner-authorized CANON. Exact dimensions, drive implementation, armament, endurance, and internal layout remain governed by Ranger-class records or future specifications.
identity_key_note: entity_id added 2026-08-09 (canon-identity-key-unification). mobile_asset records historically keyed identity as canonical_id while the other 166 canon records use entity_id, so any tool indexing only entity_id silently skipped every vessel. Both keys hold the same value; canonical_id is retained for back-compat with readers that depend on it (e.g. tools/character_capsule_adapter.py).
